cause: Training/serving skew on f1: the training pipeline applies a log1p transform (train_f1 = log(1 + raw)), but the online serving path serves the raw untransformed value. Verified on all 200 overlapping entities via a platform-side Trino join: serving_f1 == exp(train_f1) - 1 exactly, while f2-f5 are byte-identical between paths (mean absolute diff = 0.0). The log1p feature transformation is missing from the serving path.
